answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5558 Country: India Title: If someone joins the namaaz in second rakat qaida and as soon as he sits with jamaat in qaida imam stands up for third rakaat before that person completes the attaihat.......so now should he finish his attaiyat and than stand up or he should follow imam and stant up for third rakat with imam sahab without completing attaiyat. Question: If someone joins the namaaz in second rakat qaida and as soon as he sits with jamaat in qaida imam stands up for third rakaat before that person completes the attaihat.......so now should he finish his attaiyat and than stand up or he should follow imam and stant up for third rakat with imam sahab without completing attaiyat. Answer ID: 5558 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 939/705=H) One should first complete Al-tahiyaat and then stand up for third rakat, but one should recite it as quickly as one can join the Imam before rukoo. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
